description: Search certified Oklahoma records. Find reroofing and building permits (Norman 2015-present; Oklahoma City weekly residential reroofing), contractor activity, permits by address or street, a permit by number, plus Oklahoma insurance and roofing rules (contractor licensing, building code, carrier ratings, FORTIFIED roof grants). Examples: {"collection":"ok_property_permits","city":"Oklahoma City","q":"reroofing"}; {"collection":"ok_property_permits","q":"CAVINS ROOFING"}; {"collection":"ok_property_permits","permit_number":"ROOF-2026-04057"}; {"subject":"contractor_licensing","state":"OK"}. Free text goes in `q`; all other filters are exact-match, case-insensitive and combinable. Omitting `collection` searches ONLY ok_roofing_insurance (15 records) -- pass collection=ok_property_permits for permits (the response also points to it). Free, no API key. Call list_collections to see the roster.

carrier.description: Insurance collection only. Exact carrier name, e.g. "Allstate Corp." or "Triangle Insurance Company". Most records have no carrier.

city.description: ok_property_permits only (CANONICAL name; `jurisdiction_city` is accepted as an alias). Exact city: "Norman" or "Oklahoma City".

collection.description: Which collection to search. "ok_property_permits" = 8,484 Norman/Oklahoma City permit records (reroofing, construction, contractors, addresses). "ok_roofing_insurance" = 15 hand-certified insurance/roofing-regulation facts; this is the default when omitted.

county.description: ok_property_permits only (canonical; `jurisdiction_county` accepted as an alias). "Cleveland" (Norman) or "Oklahoma" (Oklahoma City).

offset.description: Skip this many matches, for paging.

permit_number.description: ok_property_permits only: exact permit number, e.g. "ROOF-2026-04057" (Oklahoma City) or "PRSF202305769" (Norman 2024+). Case-insensitive. Also shown as permit.permit_number on each record.

q.description: FREE-TEXT search (case-insensitive substring). Permits: matches permit category/type, address, contractor and permit number, e.g. "roofing", "CAVINS ROOFING", "W MAIN ST", "ROOF-2026-04057". Insurance: matches summary, detail and topic, e.g. "FORTIFIED", "Allstate", "continuing education".

state.description: Two-letter state code. All records are "OK".

status.description: Insurance: record status, one of active, superseded, expired, proposed, rescinded (all current records are "active"). Permits: the permit status, e.g. "issued".

subject.description: Exact category. Insurance collection: underwriting, claims_handling, contractor_licensing, building_code, market_conduct, regulatory_filing, insurance_industry. Permits collection: the permit category, e.g. "Residential Reroofing" (Oklahoma City), "Residential", "Single Family", "Commercial Addition/Alteration", "Demolition" (Norman). `category` is accepted as an alias.

tag.description: Exact tag. Insurance examples: "FORTIFIED", "contractor licensing", "agency M&A". Permit examples: "norman", "okc", "reroofing", "storm_shelter", "solar", "pool".

topic.description: Exact topic. Insurance: e.g. "fortified_roof_program_milestone", "roofing_contractor_annual_renewal_requirement". Permits: the permit type, e.g. "Residential Reroofing Permit".

name: search_records
